method: Every decoded frame at 30fps, grayscale 8-bit foreground ROI. Mean absolute pixel difference between consecutive frames. Interior 70% of largest foreground image; diagrams use x200,y200,w1520,h480; H02 pan uses x260,y180,w1400,h350. No downsampling, temporal filtering, dropped samples or percentile trimming. Same algorithm for v01/v02; layout-specific ROI follows the enlarged artwork.
